Nora: Small accessibility review for the Deployments dashboard filters panel. Observed: filter chips lose focus ring when closed, ARIA labels on filter toggles are missing, and NVDA reads header twice when panel opens. Quick traces below. a11y-bot: Scan flags: 5 contrast issues (chip close icon hover), 2 missing-label (filter toggle inputs), 1 live-region-dup (panel open announcement duplicated). Devon: Can you repro steps? Nora: Steps: 1) Console > Deployments > open left filters panel 2) Tab to first chip, press Enter to close Issue: focus disappears; sometimes focus goes to underlying page content. DOM sample: ```html
running
``` Also panel uses `aria-hidden` toggling and we call focus on the close handler which might conflict with screen reader's virtual cursor. Rina: For the header duplication NVDA note: panel open triggers both a toast-like aria-live="polite" and sets focus to a heading which causes two announcements. We should prefer one mechanism. Omar: Proposed fixes: - Ensure close button is focusable and receives focus on removal; prefer returning focus to the container with tabindex="-1" and then focus it. - Use visually-hidden `role="status"` area for announcements and avoid changing focus AND live update at same time. - Update button color on hover to >3:1 contrast using token `--amber-700` Nora: Also noticed screen reader doesn't read chip labels when using roving tabindex with arrow keys. We're using `aria-activedescendant` pattern but not updating `aria-selected` on the active chip. Suggest setting `aria-selected=true` for active and ensure `role="listbox"` on container. Devon: I'll take the roving tabindex -> listbox/aria-selected changes. Rina can handle the live region cleanup. Omar will adjust colors. a11y-bot: Checklist to include in PR: - [ ] Update close flow to focus fallback element (tabindex=-1) - [ ] Replace duplicate live updates with single role=status update - [ ] Add aria-selected semantics for roving listbox pattern - [ ] Color token adjustments + contrast tests - [ ] Add NVDA + VoiceOver assertions to the a11y test harness Rina: Will add notes in the PR description about expected NVDA behavior and include short audio sample. Please add a short e2e test that simulates keyboard chip close and asserts focus target. Nora: Thanks folks. Small but high impact. Prioritizing this in next sprint. :eyes:
